title: Onboarding segregation of duties and maker-checker approval
workflow: Record a proposed customer activation or high-impact change
Identify maker, legal entity, reviewer roles and SoD policy version
Freeze reviewed proposal revision and evidence digest
Route to authorized independent checker with conflict-of-interest validation
Apply approved transition once with stable command identity
Record immutable approval and notify dependent controls if decision changes risk/access
requirements: Maker cannot approve same application or risk override
Checker must have institution and approval-scope entitlement at decision time
Approval against stale proposal revision is rejected
Do not allow API/UI or scheduled job to bypass approval boundary
Emergency override requires separately approved temporary privilege and post-event review
Revoking checker authority cannot validate future requests based on old role
acceptance_cases: Same actor attempts submit and approve and gets denial
Approval after proposal change returns version conflict
Cross-institution checker cannot approve another entity's case
Repeated approve command applies one transition
approval_gate: Institution policy delegation matrix, privileged access review, test identities and signed approval rules.
